1: At the initial moment ($t=0$) the mass of a substance equals $4$ grams. Due to decay of its particles, the mass decreases: after each successive day, $19\%$ of the mass present at the end of the previous day is lost. For every non-negative integer $t$, the function $m(t)$ gives the mass of the substance, in grams, after $t$ full days (time counted from the initial moment). Find the formula for the function $m(t)$. Compute after how many full days the mass of the substance will, for the first time, be less than $1.5$ grams. Show your working.
2: Tomek and Romek decided to play five games of chess against each other. The probability that Tomek wins a single game equals $\dfrac14$. Compute the probability that Tomek wins at least four of the five games. Give the result as an irreducible common fraction. Show your working.
3: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=\dfrac{3x^2-2x}{x^2+2x+8}$ for every real number $x$. The point $P=(x_0,3)$ belongs to the graph of $f$. Compute $x_0$ and find the equation of the tangent line to the graph of $f$ at point $P$. Show your working.
7: Given is a cube $ABCDEFGH$ with edge length $6$. Point $S$ is the intersection point of diagonals $AH$ and $DE$ of the lateral face $ADHE$ (see figure). Compute the altitude of triangle $SBH$ drawn from point $S$ to side $BH$ of this triangle. Show your working. [Figure: cube ABCDEFGH, with S at the intersection of diagonals AH and DE on face ADHE]
8: Quadrilateral $ABCD$, in which $|BC|=4$ and $|CD|=5$, is circumscribed about a circle. The diagonal $AC$ of this quadrilateral makes a $60°$ angle with side $BC$, and makes an acute angle with side $AB$ whose sine equals $\dfrac14$. Compute the perimeter of quadrilateral $ABCD$. Show your working.
12.2: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=81^{\log_3 x}+\dfrac{2\cdot\log_2\sqrt{27}\cdot\log_3 2}{3}\cdot x^2-6x$ for every positive number $x$ (this expression can be shown to equal $x^4+x^2-6x$). Compute the smallest value of the function $f$. Show your working.
13: In the Cartesian coordinate system $(x,y)$, the line $l$ with equation $x-y-2=0$ intersects the parabola with equation $y=4x^2-7x+1$ at points $A$ and $B$. Segment $AB$ is a diameter of circle $\mathcal{O}$. Point $C$ lies on circle $\mathcal{O}$ above line $l$, and angle $BAC$ is acute with measure $\alpha$ such that $\tan\alpha=\dfrac13$ (see figure). Compute the coordinates of point $C$. Show your working. [Figure: parabola y=4x^2-7x+1, line l, circle O with diameter AB, point C above l with angle BAC=alpha]
